signals.text: 3 open PM roles across 1 US office

bullets: Own Memo's character. Turn the existing bio into a living character bible — personality, point of view, voice, what he likes, how he behaves under stress — that every team designs…
Own the HRI roadmap across every product surface: robot motion and gestures, audio and voice, lighting, and app state and notifications. Decide what Memo communicates, when, and…
Define and maintain the HRI trigger set: for each robot state and event, specify the user-facing response across robot and app so engineering can build to it and QA can…
Lead animation as a product area. Set briefs for animators, run reviews, and own the three objectives: legibility (a fresh-eyed user can predict what Memo's about to do)…
Own Memo's voice and sound: the voice itself, how it syncs with motion, conversational tone and register, and how voice interactions and playback feel in a real home.
Own the safety and trust roadmap for Memo. Define what "safe enough to ship" means for each release, and hold the line on it.
Build the system-level safety case. Map failure modes across navigation, hardware, controls, task design, firmware, and user communications, and make sure each has an owner, a…
Work with engineering to define and track safety test coverage for every subsystem. Ensure firmware and software releases are validated against safety requirements before OTA.
Own data privacy for the product: what Memo records in the home, who can see it (including teleoperators), how long it's kept, and how users understand and control it.
Design how Memo behaves and communicates around kids, pets, and unexpected situations — stop conditions, warnings, recovery, and what the app tells users.
Own the internal tools roadmap. Turn scattered, reactive requests into a coherent strategy that keeps maintenance costs down. Decide where tools should be combined and where…
Prioritize tools for robot testing, robot operation and fleet management based on business impact and cross-team coordination needs. Fleet management includes robot scheduling…
Define requirements for dedicated robot testing spaces: coordinate robots, people and space bookings, and support safety scanners, camera recording and live streaming. Build a…
Shape robot operation tools for distinct users: teams collecting data and evaluating robot performance, and testing, engineering and product teams running specific software…
Work with data operations and machine learning teams to scale data labeling and quality review tools as data volume grows from in-house collection, external vendors and robot…
